tasks.title: Root-owned platform branch reconciliation
steps: ROOT ONLY: verify reviewed clean tracked worktree, HEAD 2499fe8061a91d9e160409a1aea8f323deec735e, origin/main e95f887be28c6ee41786a46eb6cc58f2fbe4ba84 and merge base 91c54fa0fe4cca2cfbfe3a1b2680272c8b1cf965. Validate anchors and re-run git merge-tree; expect ONLY web/package.json conflict. If refs, worktree or conflicts changed, stop/replan. Never clean/reset or discard unrelated files, private plans or uncommitted user state.

ROOT ONLY: merge exact current main into existing PR20 branch. Resolve only web/package.json by preserving the complete test command union: upstream jiti src/features/admin/ui/signups/acquisition-model.test.ts AND PR20 jiti src/features/runners/profiles.test.ts, jiti src/features/runners/model.test.ts and node scripts/test-runner-render.mjs, plus every shared/upstream test command exactly once. Retain all other package metadata/dependency versions from the correct merged inputs; do not drop tests, regenerate lockfile unnecessarily or select one side wholesale. Stage only the deliberate conflict resolution.

Review all auto-merges, not only package.json. cmd/console/main.go must start both upstream context-bound RunAcquisitionRetention and PR20 runner bridge/proxy wiring; ui-config text keys must contain both upstream acquisition and PR20 runner keys. Preserve upstream signer DOM clearing, source acquisition permission/tenant separation and dedicated acquisition-qualification workflow; preserve runner gateway trust and runner views/configuration. Verify no duplicate mux registrations, route shadowing or silently altered canonical auth semantics.

Run npm --prefix web test and npm --prefix web run typecheck plus token checks, explicitly confirming both sets of test names appear and execute. Run generated-action consistency (go generate ./internal/actions then compare tracked generated outputs with the reconciled tree) and Go tests/vet as available. Run scripts/check.sh where prerequisites exist. For opt-in real acquisition PostgreSQL/browser and runner browser fixture checks, use only verified isolated synthetic resources with explicit opt-in, serialize schema-dropping tests, and report skips separately. Do not equate fixture browser evidence with an actual GitHub/Firecracker job.

Inspect git diff --check, both-parent merge diff, conflict markers, lockfile and staged paths; no secrets or installation-specific settings. ROOT ONLY: create the merge commit on PR20 branch after review if authorized and checks support it; report exact parents/commit and limitations. No worker handles Git merge/commit, no remote push or PR merge without root's current authorization.

checks.expected: Only web/package.json conflicts before root's merge; conflict exit status is expected.
Acquisition-model and all three runner model/profile/render tests execute and pass with existing web suite.
Panel types compile against regenerated contracts.
Applicable platform tests pass; skips and Windows/Linux limitations reported.
Generated registry, typed calls and OpenAPI remain consistent; inspect diff rather than assume.

acceptance: Root-reviewed merge preserves both test suites and all unrelated package metadata.
Both acquisition retention/signer security and runner bridge/view wiring survive merged behavior.
Generated actions and relevant checks pass or limitations are honestly recorded; no actual job or deployment is inferred.

escalation_triggers: Either branch/ref/worktree or simulated conflict set differs.
Automatic merge changes permission, route, signer, retention or proxy behavior unexpectedly.
Required generated files differ unexpectedly or tests demand unowned/live services.
A non-root worker would need to perform Git operations.
